title: Rental bond (landlords and agents)
summary: This page provides information and links for landlords and agents regarding the management and claiming of residential rental bonds in NSW.
who_can_apply: You must be a landlord or a real estate agent in NSW.
what_you_need: Access to the online services for managing bonds.

Lodge a residential rental bond (landlords and agents)
Register for a Rental Bonds Online account (landlords)

faqs.q: How can landlords and agents manage residential bonds?
faqs.a: Landlords and agents can manage residential bonds by using the online services provided by Service NSW, including checking accounts, lodging claims, and registering for accounts.

faqs.q: What services are available for managing bonds?
faqs.a: Services include checking a Rental Bonds Online account, lodging a residential bond claim, lodging a residential rental bond, and registering for a Rental Bonds Online account for landlords or agents.
